name: works-on-my-codex
description: Set up a thin Codex project harness with a compact default TUI status line.

interface.shortDescription: Set up a thin, project-specific Codex harness.
interface.longDescription: WOMC creates a thin project harness and, after hook trust, configures a compact Codex footer with the model, project, context usage, and account limits.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Works on My Codex harness in this project.
Configure the WOMC status line with model, project, context, and usage limits.
